title: Heinrich Schliemann
summary: Johann Ludwig Heinrich Julius Schliemann (1822–1890) was a German merchant and pioneer archaeologist whose excavations at Hisarlık, Mycenae, and Tiryns demonstrated the historical reality of the Aegean Bronze Age. Driven by a passion to validate Homeric epic, his aggressive excavation methods damaged stratigraphic layers, but his sensational discoveries—including the 'Treasure of Priam' and the Gold Mask of Agamemnon—transformed Aegean prehistory into a major scientific discipline.

uncertainty.note: Born 6 January 1822 in Neubukow; died 26 December 1890 in Naples.

where.historical_name: Neubukow, Grand Duchy of Mecklenburg-Schwerin, German Confederation

importance.justification: Pioneered the archaeological excavation of the Aegean Bronze Age, discovering prehistoric Troy and the Shaft Graves at Mycenae.
